resources.string: Check for updates and choose stable or beta releases
Raiun for Android publishes updates on GitHub. You can view the project and the release installed on this device.
Check GitHub about once a day. No account or cloud files are sent.
Use unmetered Wi-Fi. Installation always needs your confirmation.
Beta releases may have unfinished features or bugs. Changing channels will not downgrade the installed app.
No newer compatible Android release was found.
Updates have not been checked yet.
Android may ask you to allow installs from Raiun and confirm the update. Updating preserves your app data.
Could not check for updates. Check your connection or try again later.
This update could not be verified. Check again or download a fresh copy.
The update download did not finish. Please try again.
The downloaded file failed verification. Download the update again.
This update is for a different app and cannot be installed.
Only official release builds can be installed through this updater.
This update needs a newer Android version.
This installation already has the same or a newer version.
The APK version does not match its release. It cannot be installed.
This update uses a different signing key and cannot update this installation. Keep the current app installed to preserve your data.
There is not enough space, or the update file is unavailable. Free some space and try again.
Android could not open the installer. The update remains available in Settings.
Allow installs from Raiun in Android settings, then try Install update again.
